# device42_customer (Datasource)

Reseach customer using different parameters.

## Exemple 

```hcl
data "device42_customer" "searchCustomer" {
  name = "acmeCorp"
}

data "device42_customer" "searchCustomer2" {
  customer_id = 1
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name of the customer.
- `customer_id` (Number) ID of the customer.

### Computed

- `contact_info` (String) Contact info of the customer.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Any custom fields that will be used in device42.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `manager` (String) Customer manager.
- `notes` (String) Any additional notes.
- `tags` (String) Add or update tags to a customer (comma separated).
